title: com.steegler.matrixmedia.feed.broadcast.ended
description: Timeline event the server's bot sends when a live broadcast ends. Frozen legacy schema (ADR-0011): the payload the server sends today under the legacy name. The legacy wire-contract tests (crates/mm-api/tests/legacy_wire_contract.rs) validate real payloads against this file, so changing it changes what shipped apps are promised. The only allowed change is a new optional property that is omitted when empty.

body.description: Human-readable fallback ("<host>'s broadcast ended"); shipped apps match "broadcast ended".

msgtype.description: Fallback msgtype so non-MatrixMedia clients render the event as a notice.

m.relates_to.description: Reference to the broadcast.started event of the same stream, when its id was stored.
